project: Ivy GAP GBM anatomic cell-type deconvolution

data_source.bulk: Ivy Glioblastoma Atlas Project (Allen Institute), anatomic-structure RNA-seq
data_source.citation: Puchalski RB et al. Science 360:660-663 (2018). doi:10.1126/science.aaf2666
data_source.replaces: TCGA-GBM bulk RNA-seq (the predecessor project's cohort)

selection_criterion: mean absolute error on primary cell types, donor-held-out pseudobulk, aggregated donor-equally
survival_power: BLOCKED: tumor_details.csv is present and joins correctly, but it publishes survival_days and NO vital-status column. Who was censored is not knowable from the release, so a C-index cannot be computed. Nothing is imputed and no prognostic claim is made.

constraint_file.title: The Anatomy Test — anatomic concordance constraint file

constraints.rationale: Near-definitional: the leading edge is brain infiltrated at low tumour-cell density; cellular tumour is dense tumour. A method that fails C1 is not measuring tumour.
constraints.evidence: Ivy GAP anatomic sampling criteria; H&E and ISH characterisation of LE vs CT (Puchalski et al., Science 2018).

constraints.rationale: The leading edge retains normal white matter and cortex; cellular tumour has displaced it.
constraints.evidence: Histological definition of the LE sampling region as infiltrated but preserved brain parenchyma.

constraints.rationale: Microvascular proliferation is defined by florid endothelial proliferation. The single strongest constraint in the set.
constraints.evidence: WHO diagnostic criterion for MVP; Ivy GAP MVP dissection criterion.

constraints.rationale: Stricter form of C3: MVP must exceed all four other structures, not just CT.
constraints.evidence: As C3. Scored separately because it is a materially harder claim and a method can pass C3 while placing the endothelial maximum elsewhere.

constraints.rationale: The hypoxic peri-necrotic niche recruits myeloid cells; the leading edge does not.
constraints.evidence: Hypoxia-driven myeloid recruitment in the pseudopalisading niche; Ivy GAP ISH of myeloid markers by structure.

constraints.rationale: The perivascular niche is a documented myeloid reservoir.
constraints.evidence: Perivascular immune phenotype in GBM; CIBERSORTx analyses of Ivy GAP reporting myeloid accumulation in the perivascular zone.

constraints.rationale: A three-step monotone chain — much harder to satisfy by chance than any single pairwise step, and scored as one unit.
constraints.evidence: Ivy GAP sampling definitions place IT between LE and CT in tumour-cell density by construction.

exclusions.reason: This pipeline's own synthetic benchmark puts T cells at the detection floor, so a T-cell constraint would score noise.
exclusions.declared: before any deconvolution output was examined

untestable_by_this_signature.fact: Neuronal content is highest at the leading edge
untestable_by_this_signature.why_untestable: The seven-population roster contains no neuron column.

untestable_by_this_signature.fact: Non-neoplastic astrocytes are enriched at the leading edge
untestable_by_this_signature.why_untestable: Astrocyte is a diagnostic-only sidecar, known to be unidentifiable against Tumor; a constraint on it would score the collinearity, not the biology.

scoring.aggregation: weighted proportion satisfied, paired within tumour
scoring.null: structure labels permuted within each tumour

structurally_untestable.fact: Neuronal content is highest at the leading edge

files.description: THE LEADERBOARD. Anatomic Concordance Score per method, with a bootstrap CI over tumours and a p-value against the within-tumour label-permutation null. The two rows flagged is_control are negative controls and are what make the rest interpretable - read the control verdict in anatomic_report.json first.

THE PRIMARY RESULT. Spearman rank correlation between the ACS ranking and the ranking from real ground truth, per yardstick, against a threshold fixed before it was computed. A yardstick marked UNAVAILABLE produced no scores in this run - that is not the same as disagreeing.
The primary result with its pre-registered threshold and the requirement it was judged against (rho >= 0.60 AND a bootstrap CI excluding zero).

Each method's ACS rank beside its ground-truth rank, with the gap. This is where the agreement test is actually legible: a large gap means a method the anatomy likes and the truth does not, or vice versa.

Every constraint x every method: how many tumours could evaluate it and how many satisfied it. A constraint no method satisfies is evidence about the constraint, or about the reference - read it before reading the leaderboard.

The frozen, pre-registered constraint file: C1-C7 with directions, weights, histological citations, the declared T-cell exclusion, and the facts this signature is structurally unable to test. Its SHA-256 is the registration hash.
Machine-readable summary, including the control verdict and the note that ACS was never used to select a method.
Composition per (tumour, anatomic structure) from the best-scoring real method. One row per tumour per structure - already collapsed, so uneven block counts cannot skew anything downstream.
Per-method accuracy on donor-held-out pseudobulk with known composition. This is the ground-truth ranking the agreement test correlates ACS against, and the only evidence any method is selected on.
Per method, per cell type: MAE, RMSE, bias, correlation, the fraction invented where the type is truly absent, and the limit of detection.
The same accuracy broken down by which anatomic niche each synthetic mixture was shaped after. A method can win overall and still fail at the leading edge.
For every method reporting credible intervals: how often the interval actually contained the truth, against a nominal 0.95. Read before quoting any interval.
Which method was selected, on what criterion, with the full ranking - and the explicit record that survival and the anatomic labels were not used.
Content hashes proving every method and control was given identical inputs, identical tumours and identical folds.
For each of MuSiC, DWLS, Bisque and SCDC: whether the genuine R package ran, and if not, exactly why the Python reimplementation was used instead.

Whether the constraint file is actually pre-registered. A hash proves the constraints have not changed; it does not prove they were written before the results, which is what the pre-registration claim rests on. UNREGISTERED is the honest default and is stated as such.

Every method's configuration as run, with anything differing from its own defaults marked, and every declared departure from a tool's PUBLISHED defaults listed with the reason and when it was decided. The fairness rule is defaults with no per-method tuning, so a departure that is invisible is not defensible.

What the cell-type roster drops from the atlas, counted. Dropped populations do not leave the tissue, only the model, so their expression is absorbed by the nearest retained type - and which constraints that lands on is reported.

Each negative control scored over many independent draws, not once. The leaderboard's control rows are single draws; on real data the shuffled-signature control has a standard deviation of about 0.16 against a real-method spread of 0.29, so one draw cannot establish that the controls behave in either direction. Read this before reading a control row.

Every method x every tumour: which constraints that tumour could evaluate and which it satisfied. The protocol asks for per-tumour results explicitly, because with 9 evaluable tumours a pooled ACS can be carried by one or two of them and the pooled number alone cannot show that.

ACS for each method when only the 122 anatomic samples are deconvolved, beside ACS when all 270 archive samples are, with the rank change. Several methods use cross-sample statistics, so this measures how much of the leaderboard is a property of the method rather than of the cohort it was handed.

Protocol step 3's gate: our parse of the frozen 2014-11-25 archive checked sample-by-sample and structure-by-structure against the Allen Institute portal's own live metadata export, which is produced independently of this pipeline.

Whether a blank survival_days is missing at random. It is not: the blanks are strongly enriched for MGMT methylation and younger age, the two strongest favourable prognostic factors in GBM. Read before any survival number.

The leaderboard recomputed when every archive sample is deconvolved rather than only the anatomic ones. ACS is still scored on the anatomic subset alone - the ISH-cluster samples had their structure assigned from expression, so scoring them would be circular.
The full-database run's machine-readable summary, including how many samples were deconvolved versus how many were scored.
The canonical survival verdict. Ivy GAP publishes survival_days and no vital-status column, so who was censored is unknowable and this is BLOCKED. Nothing is imputed.

Present only if the run was explicitly asked to read recorded survival times as observed deaths. Carries the assumption, the missingness audit, and what the event count can actually detect - computed before any model was fitted.

Out-of-fold prognostic evaluation per method under that declared assumption. NOT the canonical result. Read survival_power_declared_policy.json first; on this many events every row is INCONCLUSIVE by design.
